Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

readmit 1.0.0

  • readmit retains its hospital-readmissions focus and evolves from the exploratory utilities in 0.0.1 into the Readmission Risk Pool (RRP), a project-based framework for repeated readmission risk assessment. This revision intentionally changes the public API and moves from MIT to Apache License 2.0.
  • rrp_project_init() creates a user-owned project with editable configuration, source-mapping and risk-provider scripts, branding, and a Shiny application. Project authors supply their own clinical data mapping and risk logic; rrp_project_validate() checks the authoring structure, and rrp_state_init() establishes persistent history.
  • rrp_run() assesses the remaining risk of a first readmission through 30 elapsed days after discharge at a chosen analytical time. It applies shared eligibility rules to project-supplied canonical data and retains accepted estimates, provider failures, and ineligible outcomes. Use rrp_project_status() and rrp_inspect_history() to examine the results.
  • rrp_refresh_products() derives current remaining risk, recorded risk trajectories, and an operational scope summary as CSV files from retained history. The project-owned Shiny app opens with empty views before products exist and displays them after refresh.
  • A short installed getting-started vignette and a reproducible website implementation guide demonstrate the project workflow with illustrative data and risk logic. No clinically validated prediction model is included.
